senses.gloss:
अशन्, आ, m., Ved. a missile-stone, or stone for
slinging, stone, rock; a cloud.

असन् असन्, the base of some of the cases
of असृज्, blood, q. v.; thus, inst. अस्ना, gen. अस्नस्, &c.

आसन् आसन्, n. [cf. 2. आस् and आस्य], Ved.
the mouth, the jaws; (this word occurs in inst.,
dat., abl., loc. sing., and inst. plur.)
—आसन्न्-इषु,
उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. one who has arrows in his mouth.
1. अशन, अस्, आ, अम्, reaching, reaching across.

2. अशन, अम्, n. eating, feeding; food (often at the
end of compounds, e. g. मूल-फलाशन, अस्, आ, अम्,
having roots and fruit for food).
—अशन-कृत्, त्, त्, त्,
Ved. preparing food.
—अशन-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord
of food.
—अशन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessed
of food.

अशन 3. अशन, अस्, m. = असन, N. of the
tree Terminalia Tomentosa W. and A.
—अशन-
पर्णी or असन-पर्णी, f., N. of a plant.
अशन, अशनि। See under 1. अश्, 2. अश्.
असन, अम्, n. the act of throwing, &c. See s. v.

असन असन, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 2. अस्), throwing,
sending; a shot; (अस्), m., N. of the tree Termi-
nalia Tomentosa, see अशन.
—असन-पर्णी, f., N.
of the plant Marsilea Quadrifolia, see अशन-पर्णी.
असना, f., Ved. a missile, an arrow.

असन्न अ-सन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. restless,
without rest or repose.

आशन आशन, अस्, m., N. of the tree
Pentaptera Tomentosa. See 3. अशन.

1. आसन, अम्, n. sitting, sitting down; sitting in
peculiar postures, according to the custom of devotees,
(five or, in other places, even eighty-four postures are
enumerated; see पद्मासन, भद्रासन, वज्रा-
सन, वीरासन, स्वस्तिकासन: the manner of
sitting forming part of the eight-fold observances of
ascetics); halting, stopping, encamping; abiding,
dwelling; seat, place, stool; the withers of an ele-
phant, the part where the driver sits; maintaining a
post against an enemy; (आ), f. stay, abiding; (ई), f.
stay, abiding, sitting; a shop, a stall; a small seat, a
stool.

2. आसन, अम्, n. throwing; (अस्), m., N. of a
tree. See असन.
आसन आसन, See under 4. आस् and 2. आस.

आ-सन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, near, proximate; (अस्), m.
the setting sun.
—आसन्न-काल, अस्, m. the hour of
death; one whose last hour is at hand.
—आसन्न-
तर, अस्, आ, अम्, nearer.
—आसन्नतर-ता, f. greater
nearness.
—आसन्न-प्रसव, अस्, आ, अम्, near par-
turition, about to bring forth or to lay eggs.

अशनि, इस्, m. f. a missile, especially the thunder-
bolt and flash of lightning; the tip of a missile; N.
of a warrior-tribe.
—अशनि-प्रभ, अस्, m., N. of a
Rākṣasa.
—अशनि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. throwing
the thunderbolt, endowed with it.

अशनाय, nom. P. -यति, -यितुम्, to desire food,
to be hungry.
अशनाया, f. hunger.
अशनायित or अशनायुक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hungry.

अशकुन अ-शकुन, अम्, n. an inauspicious
omen.

अशकुम्भी अश-कुम्भी, f., N. of the aquatic
plant Pistia Stratiotes Lin.

अशक्त अ-शक्त, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. शक्), unable,
incompetent.
—अशक्त-ता, f. or अशक्त-त्व, अम्, n.
weakness, inability.

अ-सक्त; add — uninterrupted; (अम्), ind. un-
interruptedly.
आ-शक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, able, powerful, capable.

आ-सक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, attached strongly to or intent
on; zealously following or pursuing; trusting to,
confiding in, eternal; (अम्), ind. eternally.
—आसक्त-
चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having the mind deeply engaged
in, intent on, devoted to, absorbed in.
—आसक्त-
चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the mind fixed or intent on
any object.
—आसक्त-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the
mind fixed upon any object.

अ-शक्ति, इस्, f. inability, incapability, weakness,
impotence.
आ-शक्ति, इस्, f. power, ability, might.

आ-सक्ति, इस्, f. devotedness or attachment (as to
one object or pursuit), diligence, application; Ved.
lying wait for, way-laying; (इ), ind., Ved. purposely,
intentionally.

अ-शक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, impossible, impracticable;
not to be done.
—अशक्यार्थ (˚य-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
unavailing.

अशग अशग, अस्, m., N. of the author of
the Śāntipurāṇa.

अशङ्क अ-शङ्क, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. शङ्क्), fear-
less, undaunted; secure, certain.

आ-शङ्का, f. fear, apprehension; doubt, uncertainty;
distrust, suspicion.
—आशङ्कान्वित (˚का-अन्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, apprehensive, doubting, uncertain; afraid.
अ-शङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, certain, undoubted; fearless.
आ-शङ्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, feared, dreaded; doubted.
अशठ अ-शठ, अस्, आ, अम्, virtuous, sincere.

अशत्रु अ-शत्रु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. one who has
no adversary; one whom no enemy defies; without
opposition from enemies; (उस्), m. the moon; (उ),
n. condition of having no enemy.

अशपत् अ-शपत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. not curs-
ing, not imprecating.

अशम् अ-शम्, ind. (rt. शम्), Ved. non-wel-
fare, harm, mischief.
अ-शम, अस्, m. disquietude, uneasiness.

असम अ-सम, अस्, आ, अम्, uneven, unequal
either in surface or number; odd; unequalled, indi-
vidual, without a fellow or equal; (अस्), m. a N. of
Buddha or a Buddha.
—असम-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. possessed of an unequalled chariot.
—असम-
वाण or असम-सायक, अस्, m. or असमेषु (˚म-
इष्˚), उस्, m. having an odd number of arrows, i. e.
[]
the five-arrowed, an epithet of Kāma.
—असमौजस्
(˚म-ओज्˚), आस्, m., N. of a person.

अ-शान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, unappeased, indomitable,
violent, wild; restless, anxious, unresigned; uncon-
secrated, not sacred, irreligious, profane.
—अशान्त-
ता, f. want of tranquillity, passionateness.

अ-शान्ति, इस्, f. restlessness, anxiety.
—अशान्ति-कर,
अस्, ई, अम्, causing anxiety.
अ-शाम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, unappeasable.

असाम्य अ-साम्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-सम), dif-
ference, dissimilarity; unsuitableness (in medicine or
diet), unwholesomeness; disagreeableness.

अशरण अ-शरण, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of
refuge, defenceless.

अशरीर अ-शरीर, अस्, आ, अम्, bodiless, in-
corporeal; (अस्), m. a N. of Kāma, the god of love.
अ-शरीरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, incorporeal.

अशर्मन् अ-शर्मन्, अ, n. unhappiness, pain,
affliction; (आ, आ, अ), unhappy, afflicted.

अशस् अ-शस्, अस्, अस्, अस् (rt. शस् for संस्),
Ved. not blessing, not wishing well, not praising,
cursing, hating.
आ-शस्, अस्, f., Ved. wish, desire, hope; (Say.) praise.

आशास् आ-शास्, cl. 2. P. -शास्ति, -शासितुम्, to
order, command, relate; A. -शास्ते, to wish well
towards, pray for; to praise; to desire.

अ-शस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. inexpressible, ineffable,
not esteemed, hated, ill-starred.
—अशस्त-वार, अस्,
आ, अम्, Ved. having indescribable treasures; (Sāy.)
who is not asked for wealth, i. e. who grants it of his
own accord.

अ-शस्ति, इस्, f., Ved. not wishing well, imprecation,
evil design, curse; a curser, hater.
—अशस्ति-हन्, आ,
घ्नी, अ, Ved. averting imprecations or curses.

अशस्त्र अ-शस्त्र, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. शस्, to hurt),
weaponless, unarmed.

अ-शास्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, unscriptural, not conformable to
sacred authority, heterodox.
—अ-शास्त्र-विहित or अ-
शास्त्र-सिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, not enjoined by the Śāstras.
अशाखा अ-शाखा, f., N. of a grass.

अशारीरिक अ-शारीरिक, अस्, ई, अम्, not re-
lating to or endowed with body, incorporeal.

अशाश्वत अ-शाश्वत, अस्, ई, अम्, perishable,
transient, temporary.

अशासन अ-शासन, अम्, n. (rt. शास्), want of
government, anarchy, disorder.

आशसन आ-शसन, अम्, n. (rt. शस्), Ved.
cutting up an animal when killed.
अ-शासनीय or अ-शास्य, अस्, आ, अम्, ungovernable.
अ-शासित, अस्, आ, अम्, ungoverned, undisciplined.

अ-शास्त्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, unscriptural, heterodox,
illegal, immoral, irreligious.

अषडक्षीण अषडक्षीण, अम्, n. (fr. अ,
षष्, अक्षि), anything not seen by six eyes, i. e.
known or determined by two persons to the ex-
clusion of a third; a secret.

अषतर अषतर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (fr. a
positive, which is not preserved, but may be referred
to rt. 1. अश्), more accessible or acceptable.

अषाढ अ-षाढ, or Ved. अ-षाऌह, अस्, आ, अम्,
not to be overcome, invincible; born under the
constellation Aṣāḍhā; (अस्), m. the month Aṣāḍha
(or Āṣāḍha), commencing with the sun's entrance
into Gemini (June-July); a staff made of the wood
of Palāśa, carried by a student during the performance
of certain vows; N. of a teacher; N. of the Malaya
mountain; (आ), f., N. of a sacred brick; N. of a
constellation; pl. the eighteenth and nineteenth or
twentieth and twenty-first lunar mansions.
आशाढ आशाढ for आषाढ, q. v.

आषाढ आषाढ, अस्, m. (fr. अ-षाढा), N.
of a month, corresponding to part of June and July,
in which the full moon is near the constellation
Aṣāḍhā; a staff of the wood of the Palāśa, carried
by an ascetic during certain vows in the month
Āṣāḍha; N. of a prince; the Malaya mountain;
(आ), f. the twenty-first and twenty-second lunar
mansions, commonly compounded with पूर्व and
उत्तर; (ई), f. the day of full moon in the month
Āṣāḍha.
—आषाढ-भव, अस्, आ, अम्, produced
in the month Āṣāḍha; (अस्), m. the planet Mars.
—आषाढ-भूति, इस्, m., N. of a man.
—आषाढा-
[]
भू, ऊस्, m. produced in the month Āṣāḍha; the
planet Mars.

अषाढक, अस्, m. the month Aṣāḍha (or
Āṣāḍha).

आषाढक, अस्, m. the month Āṣāḍha; N. of a
man.

असंयत् अ-संयत्, अन्, अती, अत् (rt. इ), Ved.
not entering, not pleasing.

असंयत्त अ-संयत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, (rt. यत्), Ved.
undisturbed, (various reading for अ-संयत.)

अ-संयत, अस्, आ, अम्, unrestrained, unassailed.
—असंयतात्मन् (˚त-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, having the
soul uncontrolled.

असंयम अ-संयम, अस्, m. (rt. यम्), ab-
sence of check or restraint, especially of the senses.

असंयुक्त अ-संयुक्त, अम्, n. (rt. युज्), non-
combination, hiatus (in Vedic grammar).

अ-संयोग, अस्, m. absence of union or connec-
tion.

असंयुत अ-संयुत, अस्, m. unmixed, un-
blended; an epithet of Viṣṇu.

असंरुद्ध अ-संरुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, unob-
structed.

असंलग्न अ-संलग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, disjoined,
detached, separate.

असंवत्सरभृत अ-संवत्सर-भृत, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. not supported a whole year (as a sacred fire).

अ-संवत्सरभृतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. one who
does not support (a fire) a whole year.

असंविदान अ-संविदान, अस्, आ, अम्, ignorant,
unwise; not promising or covenanting.

असंवृत अ-संवृत, अस्, आ, अम्, uncovered,
exposed; imperfectly or scarcely covered.

असंव्यवहितम् अ-संव्यवहितम्, ind. im-
mediately, without interval.

असंशय अ-संशय, अस्, m. absence of
doubt; (अस्, आ, अम्), free from doubt, certain.
—अ-
संशयम्, ind. without doubt, certainly, verily.

अ-संश्रावम्, ind. inaudibly, out of the hearing
of (with gen. of the person).

असंश्लिष्ट अ-संश्लिष्ट, अस्, m. not joined,
not in contact, an epithet of Śiva.

असंसक्त अ-संसक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, not attached
to, not joined together, disunited, indifferent to.

असंसिद्ध अ-संसिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, unac-
complished, incomplete.

असंसूक्तगिल अ-संसूक्त-गिल, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. swallowing whole or without chewing (said of
Rudra's dogs).

असंसृति अ-संसृति, इस्, f. not returning to
a new course of existence, absorption into the supreme
spirit.

असंसृष्ट अ-संसृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, unmixed
with, separate, not living in common.

असंस्कृत अ-संस्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, not perfect,
unpolished, rude, common; uninitiated, not having
gone through the proper rites of caste, state, sex, or
age.

असंस्तुत अ-संस्तुत, अस्, आ, अम्, unknown,
unacquainted, not known as acquaintances; not on
terms of friendship.

असंस्थान अ-संस्थान, अम्, n. (rt. स्था),
absence of cohesion or configuration; disorder, confu-
sion; want, destitution.

अ-संस्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, not arranged or arrayed,
disordered, irregular; not collected; not finished, not
accomplished; not ceasing, not stopping; destitute.

अ-संस्थिति, इस्, f. disorder, confusion; want, desti-
tution.

असंहत अ-संहत, अस्, आ, अम्, not joined;
[]
scattered, loose, straggling, uncompressed; (अम्), n.
a form of array, loose or open order of troops.

असंहार्य अ-संहार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, irresistible,
insuperable.

असंहित अ-संहित, अस्, आ, अम्, not included
in the संहिता of the Veda.

असकल अ-सकल, अस्, आ, अम्, not all, not
entire, a part.

असकृत् अ-सकृत्, ind. not once, oftener
than once, again and again, repeatedly.
—असकृत्-
समाधि, इस्, m. repeated meditation.
—असकृद्-
गर्भ-वास, अस्, m. repeated birth.

असक्थ अ-सक्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, without thighs,
thighless.

असक्र अ-सक्र, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. सश्च्), Ved. not
ceasing to flow, not drying up; not going elsewhere.

असखि अ-सखि, आ, m. an untrustworthy
friend.
अ-सखिन्, आ, m. an enemy, an adversary.

असगोत्र अ-सगोत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, of a different
family.

असङ्कल्प अ-सङ्कल्प, अस्, अम्, m. n. absence
of predetermination, absence of interested purpose,
sincerity.

अ-सङ्कल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, not purposed, not re-
solved or determined on.

असङ्कसुक अ-सङ्कसुक, अस्, आ, अम्, not fickle,
unfluctuating, firm, steady.

असङ्कीर्ण अ-सङ्कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, unmixed,
uncompounded, uncollected.

असङ्कुल अ-सङ्कुल, अस्, आ, अम्, not crowded,
open, clear, broad; (अस्), m. a broad road.

असङ्केत अ-सङ्केत, अस्, आ, अम्, not appointed,
not agreed upon.
अ-सङ्केतित, अस्, आ, अम्, uninvited.

असङ्ख्य अ-सङ्ख्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. ख्या),
without number, innumerable, exceedingly numerous.
—असङ्ख्य-ता, f. or असङ्ख्य-त्व, अम्, n. innu-
merableness, immensity, infinity.
अ-सङ्ख्यात, अस्, आ, अम्, uncounted, innumerable.

अ-सङ्ख्येय, अस्, आ, अम्, innumerable; (अस्), m.
an epithet of Śiva; (अम्), n., Ved. an innumerable
multitude; an exceedingly large number.
—असङ्-
ख्येय-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, innumerable, unnumbered.
—असङ्ख्येय-ता, f. innumerableness.

असङ्ग 1. अ-सङ्ग, अस्, m. (rt. सञ्ज्), non-
attachment; (अस्, आ, अम्), not attached, having no
attachment or inclination for or interest in, inde-
pendent, free from ties, not hindered, moving without
hindrance.
—असङ्ग-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, not attached
to.

असङ्ग 2. अ-सङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. गम् with
सम् and अ prefixed), not united, unassociated, soli-
tary; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Yuyudhāna.

आ-सङ्ग, अस्, m. fastening to, fixing; association,
connection; attachment to any object; proximity,
contact; Ved. way-laying; N. of a man; (अम्), n.
a kind of fragrant earth; (अस्, आ, अम्), uninterrupted,
eternal; (अम्), ind. without interruption; eternally.
अ-सङ्गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, not attached to the world.

असज्जितात्मन् (˚त-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, having a soul
free from attachments.

अ-सङ्गत, अस्, आ, अम्, ununited, unaccompanied,
unassociated with; uneven, unequal; improbable, in-
consistent; unpreferred, disesteemed; unbecoming,
unseemly; rude, ill-mannered, unpolished, clownish.
—असङ्गताचरण (˚त-आच्˚), अम्, n. inconsistent
conduct.

अ-सङ्गति, इस्, f. not associating; incongruity, im-
probability.

अ-सङ्गम, अस्, m. not associating with; separa-
tion, disunion; incongruity; inequality.

असचद्विष् अ-सच-द्विष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. per-
secuting those who are not (his) worshippers; having
no enemies.
